comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 requires an explicit acknowledgment that the OP's point or view is valid or reasonable (the cognitive or argumentative content) before a disagreement. Item 1 requires explicit validation of the OP's emotional experience or feelings before a rebuttal. Item 1 also says validation of the OP's reasoning does not count, which is exactly what item 0 measures. The two features would give different labels on the same comment.
